The first one! Potato reads the words in your screenshots so you can search them, and tidies away old QR codes, boarding passes and login codes after a week.

- search every screenshot on your phone, and new ones shortly after you take them
- filters for QR codes, boarding passes, login codes and what's leaving soon
- tidy after 1 day, 3 days, a week or two weeks, or turn it off
- a keep switch for anything you want to hang on to
- dark mode, because Potato wears sunglasses anyway

Needs Android 11 or newer. Download **octo-potato.apk** below and open it on your phone. Android will ask to allow installs from your browser, that's normal for apps outside the Play Store.
